d: The wife of a tough police detective hires Mannix to find her son, who she believes was involved in an armored-car robbery.
A rival private investigator pressures Cannon in the matter of a drinking-establishment fire.
Barnaby's cousin comes to solve a murder.
An elderly man solves the murder of a young woman who lived in the apartment building he manages.
Friday and Gannon find life in the Business Office Division busier than they expected.
Two officers are ambushed by members of a militant group.
Hogan aids a Russian spy to keep the Nazis from finding a radio station.
Teddy Roosevelt enlists Bill as a spy. Bill looks to Sixties spies for inspiration.
Lumpy wins the athletic scholarship for which he and Wally were competing.
Beaver resents his mother's sending him on an errand at an inopportune time.

st: The Case of the Golden Fraud
d: Perry gets caught between two rivals for an executive position in an investment firm; guest Arthur Franz.
A con artist facing execution for murder exasperates Ben while having his case appealed.
A sudden loss shakes the Five-0 team during an investigation of a Chinatown crime operation; guest Reni Santoni.
The Waltons aid an actress (Pippa Scott) whose chauffeur robbed and abandoned her after her car broke down.
Chester gives up his old life in favor of farming when he falls in love.
Former Civil War prisoners seeking revenge surround Ben, Hoss and Ben's friend (J.D. Cannon), a former Confederate prison commandant.
A convict is released from prison and returns home to North Fork.
Lucas helps his former Army captain, now an undercover federal agent, infiltrate a gang of bank robbers.
Flint finds the ruins of a farmhouse which was attacked by Indians using guns, not arrows; he later finds the gunrunner who supplied them.
Gage falls for an overzealous, undercover police officer (Sharon Gless); a series of thefts of equipment plagues Rampart Emergency.
Col. Potter learns new military money is being issued in hopes of confusing counterfeiters.
Nurse Cooper can't cope with the operating room; Radar gets a tattoo.
Alarmed at the poor physical condition of his unit, Col. Potter decides to hold an M*A*S*H Olympics.
Winchester and Hot Lips get food poisoning from an imported can of pheasant; Hawkeye is reprimanded for fighting.
Opie finds a purse containing $50, but Andy tells him that the money will only be his if no one claims it within a week. Soon, Opie gets the money but has to return it.
Andy lets Barney take over as sheriff for a day when he goes to Raleigh to attend a job interview. By the time he returns, Barney has turned the whole town upside down.
Ray and Debra try to be nicer to each other; Ray meets Doug at Dr. Becker's office.
Ray urges Debra to go dancing with Robert but becomes increasingly jealous of the situation.

st: Guess Who's Coming to the Wedding
d: Dorothy must face her ex-husband Stanley Zbornak when her daughter announces her upcoming wedding.
Rose finds herself romantically involved for the first time since her husband's death.
Skits: "Barbary and Ben"; "Rancid Harvest.".

st: The Case of the Silent Six
d: A police officer faces charges of slaying his sister's tormentor; guest Skip Homeier.
A playwright describes characters into his tape recorder, and they materialize before his eyes.
A man (Gary Merrill) on the ledge of a New York City hotel threatens suicide after his wife's (Elizabeth Montgomery) death.
A gun shop owner (Art Carney) witnesses the murder of a state witness by two gangsters. With Mary Scott.
Mannix discovers he needs a cryptology expert when he tries to clear the name of Peggy's late husband in a police payoff case.
Cannon aids a sheep rancher charged in the death of an illegal Mexican immigrant caught in a coyote trap.
A reporter (John Rubenstein) has a clue to the murder of a state official who uncovered a land-development scam.

st: The Ballad of the Everyday Housewife
d: When it seems Steve is taking Betty Jo for granted, Bobbie Jo tries to make him act more demonstrative.
Five eminently qualified and extremely jealous rivals volunteer to be Kathy Jo's godfather.
The hillbillies move back to the hills to find Elly a husband, much to Mr. Drysdale's dismay.
The Clampetts arrive in the mountain town of Silver Dollar City, where Granny starts a feud.
Popeye, Bluto, Olive Oyl and all his seafaring friends star in these original theatrical cartoons from the genius of Max Fleischer; included are Betty Boop and Bimbo shorts.
Adventures of the animated cat and mouse.

A collection of timeless cartoon shorts that span from 1934 to 1972, featuring the mischievous Woody Woodpecker and his colorful cast of friends including Chilly Willy, The Beary Family, Inspector Willoughby, Andy Panda, and more.

t: A Very Merry Bugs Bunny Christmas
d: Celebrating the season with Bugs Bunny, Tweety, Daffy and more with the three original shorts featured in the 1979 television special, "Bugs Bunny's Looney Christmas Tales," and three extra holiday cartoons.

st: The Night of the Whirring Death
d: Loveless plans to make California a children's haven by extorting cash from millionaires.
On Christmas Eve, a young boy wanders off to find Santa Claus.
Jarrod tries to reform an outlaw's girlfriend (Lynn Loring) by having her spend Christmas with the Barkleys.
Seven homeless children spend Christmas on their way from a Kansas orphanage to California.
A shady manager (Jack Oakie) involves his singer nephew (Wayne Newton) in a Christmas fund-raising drive.
Cheyenne waits out a winter with a cattle drive.
A man (Ed Wynn) dressed as Santa Claus claims to be celebrating Christmas early for the sake of a dying Mexican boy.
Paladin must help a man and his pregnant wife find shelter on Christmas Eve. Starring Richard Boone and Duane Eddy.
A boy hires Josh to bring in Santa Claus.
The trio tries to free an innocent man from jail.
A social misfit uses his only friends, his pet rats, to exact revenge on his tormentors.
A man recovering from a nervous breakdown sees a horrifying creature on the wing of his plane. With William Shatner.
Spock must destroy an asteroid threatening a primitive world where lost and amnesiac Kirk has taken a wife.
Kolchak theorizes a vampire is behind a string of deaths from Las Vegas to Los Angeles, in which bodies were left drained of blood.
Will uses the matter-transfer unit to return to Earth, but no one there believes his story.

t: Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
d: The Seaview rushes a young prince back to assume his country's throne before a new faction can take over.
Four of the earth people discover a new land when they are carried across the sea in a child's balloon.
Claiming to know where the saucer landed, a local stripper (Suzanne Pleshette) leads Vincent into the Mexican desert.

It appears that wealthy and prominent members of the community have been executing crimes and then forgetting that they ever happened. Eventually the Green Hornet finds that a spa owner has been leaving "suggestions" in these people's subconscious.

The Green Hornet pays a visit to spa owner Peter Eden and offers a proposition for Peter Eden. After Eden uses Vanessa Vane to double-cross the Hornet, the Hornet returns and uses Eden's dream machine on Peter to foil the last crime of the evening.

t: The Life and Times of Grizzly Adams
d: A father learns to be kind after his unfriendly behavior nearly causes him to lose his son.
Marlin visits the Grand Teton Mountains in the U.S. and the wilderness north of Canada to capture the territorial fight, the rescue of a baby moose and to see the sandhill cranes.
Climb the Philmont Trail near Cimarron in northern New Mexico.
A leopard cub grows to maturity in the Kalahari Desert.
A leopard cub grows to maturity in the Kalahari Desert.
The life cycle of the golden eagle.
The odd ways some animals move.
Carol loses her voice from too much choir practice and fears she may not be able to sing in the Christmas service.

The Monkees are charged with helping a cynical young boy rediscover the spirit of Christmas, in this hilarious holiday episode co-starring Munsters mainstay Butch Patrick and featuring Christmas classics such as Deck The Halls, Jingle Bells, and The 12 Days Of Christmas, among others.
When Granny, Uncle Jed, Elly May and Jethro decide to return to the country for the holidays, they discover airline travel.
The Clampetts, home for Christmas, help Cousin Pearl woo Mr. Brewster, the big oil company executive.
Blizzard, a young reindeer living at the North Pole, and his unique group of friends band together to save the future of Christmas, creating a magical holiday tradition in the process.
Beaver loses the money his father gave him for a haircut.
Dave and Rick earn some Christmas money on their own.

st: Birds Gotta Fly, Fish Gotta Talk
d: The castaways learn that the Coast Guard has sighted them and is sending a cutter to the rescue.

t: The Many Loves of Dobie Gillis
st: Will the Real Santa Claus Please Come Down the Chimney
d: Maynard believes in Santa Claus.
Mama's not in the merriest of moods when she's forced to play Santa at the mall.
A live goose, meant to be Christmas dinner, becomes a pet.
The Cunninghams plan a quiet family Christmas until they discover that Fonzie faces a lonely holiday.
At Christmas, a merchant seaman from the Orient delivers a gift to Fonzie from his long-lost father.

st: Lonely at the Top; Divorce Me, Please; Silent Night
d: A priest travels with six orphans; a couple pretends to be compatible; a wrongly convicted man meets the person he holds responsible.
Blanche must decide whether to donate one of her kidneys to the sister she hates.

George Simonson isn't just a toy collector, he's a collector of collections. After decades of collecting thousands of toys, he's amassed an entire basement filled with shelves and shelves of complete toy lines from the 1980s. Now he's sharing them with Lisa and expert appraiser and toy shop owner, Jonathan Schoonveld. Together, they travel through his archive of 80s toy nostalgia, including his Wo
At Christmastime, Hawkeye writes a letter to his father describing what a doctor's life is like at the 4077th.
Father Mulcahy writes a pre-Christmas letter home to his sister.
Dorothy's attractive date flirts with Blanche, sparking a rivalry between the two.
Blanche's unruly teenage grandson visits, and goes out every night with a rough crowd.
Sophia takes action when a depressed, gun-toting Santa Claus threatens to ruin Christmas for her and her housemates.

st: Have Yourself a Very Little Christmas
d: The ladies grow tired of Christmas shopping during a heat wave; they volunteer to serve Christmas dinner at a soup kitchen.
Ray is upset when he discovers that the autographed Mickey Mantle baseball his dad gave him years earlier is a fake, so he decides to tell Ally the truth about Santa.
A romantic Christmas morning ends when Ray's family bursts in for eggs Florentine and unwrapping gifts.
Archie is depressed because he did not get his usual Christmas bonus.
The Bunker household's Christmas mood turns grim when Edith tells Gloria she is going for a surgical examination.
The entire "Alan Brady" staff presents a Christmas show instead of the script turned in by the writers.
After turning down the role of Scrooge in a Christmas play, Oscar kicks Felix out of the apartment.
The Kramdens and the Nortons gather in the Kramden apartment to share the joys of Christmas.
Christmas means sad memories for Bob's therapy group, and it's evident that 'tis not the season for everyone to be jolly. Bob decides to invite the group over for Christmas Eve.
Rollin and Barney travel into Eastern Europe to aid a scientist to defect and join his recently-escaped wife in the West.
Dr. Richard Kimble (David Janssen), innocent but charged with murdering his wife, begins a long flight from the law.
Still under suspicion of murder, Harry enlists Quinlan's help to uncover who is behind the corporation buying ranch land.
Friday and Gannon introduce the use of dogs to the LAPD to sniff out marijuana.
A fellow officer tries to include Friday in a gambling operation.
A young woman tries to cash a found check; Reed and Malloy are accused of poaching in another officer's territory; a thief is found hiding in a mortuary.
Hogan and his men are determined to destroy a Nazi gasoline station at Stalag 13.
Toony and Bill tour the U.S. territory of Guam, from its waterfalls to its foods.
Ward and June go away for the weekend and leave Ward's Uncle Billy in charge of the boys.
Beaver becomes homesick when he contemplates his upcoming transfer to a prep school.

st: The Case of the Bartered Bikini
d: A model suspected of selling bathing-suit designs to her employer's competition becomes involved in murder.
A dissatisfied patient is suspected of murdering her plastic surgeon, but Ben thinks otherwise.
McGarrett calls on a Pentagon agent (Steve Kanaly) after an operative is slain probing a research organization.
The drunken father of a young friend of the Waltons burns down the schoolhouse in the name of religion.
A ruthless gunman, out to defy law and order, comes up against Matt Dillon.
Matt Dillon tries to protect a notorious gunman who is just out of prison and trying to go straight but keeps getting in trouble.
Hoss and Little Joe raise rabbits for fur coats, then find they lack the heart to finish the job; guest Dub Taylor.
Lucas helps a woman who is being harassed by a rough gambler.
An ex-convict is accused of robbing and killing his employer.
When a group of Scottish people join the wagon train as a protection against Indian attacks, two disparate young people fall in love.
A former Vietnam medic volunteers to train as a paramedic, but his quick diagnoses and independent medical efforts yield disaster.
Hawkeye and Margaret go to give a demonstration at the 8063rd.
Hawkeye and Hot Lips come under heavy artillery fire in enemy territory, with Hawkeye receiving a leg wound.
B.J. borrows $200 from Charles to send to his wife, only to have Charles take advantage of him in various ways.
Charles' French horn practicing causes Hawkeye and B.J. to go on a bath strike.
The Darling family returns to Mayberry to look for a husband for Charlene's newborn daughter. Things get complicated when they choose Opie and refuse to take no for an answer.

st: Andy and Helen Have Their Day
d: Andy and Helen take a day off to go on a picnic, but are constantly interrupted by Barney, Goober and other people.
Ray offers his basement office to Robert and Amy when they want to be alone.
Ray and Debra prepare Ally for her first play date and reflect on their own first meeting and kiss.
Sophia challenges Dorothy to prove she is spry enough to take a trip to Italy.
After a burglar enters the house, Rose buys a gun to feel more safe.
Guest: Tim Conway.

st: The Case of the Fugitive Fraulein
d: Perry travels behind the Berlin Wall to defend a woman accused of slaying an East German agent; guest Jeanette Nolan.
A downed bomber pilot crash-lands in the desert; when he regains consciousness he can not find any of his crew members.
